title: Portable Portraits
content: Painting spontaneous portraits of strangers on location leads to unforgettable encounters.(Direct link to video) The new Fall 2011 issue ofWatercolormagazine (published by American Artist) contains an article that I just wrote on the topic of “Portable Portraits.”It goes into detail about the materials, methods, and mindset that you might want to try for sketching people on location.------LINKSAmerican Artist DailyWhat's in My Bag?
